{{Quote|Stand and do your duty! We owe our loyalty to a throne, not a man!|Kiefer|<ref name="legacy3" />}}
'''Kiefer''' was a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]]. After [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]] was [[Attack on Emperor Fel|overthrown]] by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] [[Darth Krayt]], a number of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]] remained loyal to Fel. However, Kiefer&mdash;who believed that it was his duty to serve whomever was on the throne, rather than a specific individual&mdash;in turn was loyal to Krayt. When Fel [[Fall of Bastion|arrived]] on Bastion in [[137 ABY]], Kiefer commanded him to surrender. However, Fel refused to do so, and much to Kiefer's dismay, none of the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] accompanying the lieutenant enforced his order. Kiefer responded by drawing his [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] to [[Death/Legends|kill]] Fel himself, but before he could do so, one of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Oron Jaeger]]'s stormtroopers shot and killed the lieutenant.

==Biography==
{{Quote|The ''true'' emperor, Darth Krayt, has ordered your arrest. Surrender!|Kiefer to Roan Fel|<ref name="legacy3" />}}
[[File:Fel_Bastion.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Kiefer found his stormtroopers unwilling to shoot Emperor Fel.]]
[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] Kiefer was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served in the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] on [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]], the former [[Planet/Legends|throneworld]] of the [[Fel Empire]]. In [[130 ABY]], [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]] had been [[Attack on Emperor Fel|overthrown]] by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], [[Darth Krayt]]. When Fel [[Fall of Bastion|arrived]] on Bastion in [[137 ABY]], Kiefer greeted him, accompanied by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], and demanded that the [[Empire-in-exile|former emperor]] surrender to be arrested.<ref name="legacy3" />

However, to Kiefer's chagrin, Fel instead stated that he was there to take control of the planet. Defying Kiefer's orders to do their duty to their true [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]], Darth Krayt, the stormtroopers instead bowed to Fel.<ref name="legacy3" /> Kiefer drew his [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]],<ref name="CSWE" /> stating that he would execute his orders. Before Kiefer could shoot, however, one of the stormtroopers serving [[General/Legends|General]] [[Oron Jaeger]]&mdash;who still considered Fel to be the true ruler&mdash;fired at Kiefer, [[Death/Legends|killing]] him.<ref name="legacy3" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Well, I know my duty, and I will execute it!|Kiefer|<ref name="legacy3" />}}
[[File:Kiefer-Fel.png|thumb|right|200px|Kiefer did not believe Fel to be the true Emperor.]]
Kiefer believed that his loyalty was to the throne, not the being who held it, and thus considered Fel a fugitive from justice, as Krayt had called for his arrest. Kiefer did not understand why no one else ordered Fel to surrender, and so when the stormtrooper contingent with him refused to kill the former Emperor, Kiefer attempted to take matters into his own hands. Fel believed that Kiefer was just one of many people who had been brainwashed by Darth Krayt and [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|his new policies]]. Kiefer had [[black]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and light skin.<ref name="legacy3" />

==Equipment==
Kiefer wore an [[Imperial officer's uniform/Legends|Imperial officer's uniform]] and was armed with a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]].<ref name="legacy3" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kiefer's only appearance is in the third issue of the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series, [[Legacy (2006) 3|''Broken, Part 3'']],<ref name="legacy3" /> published on [[September 13]], [[2006]].<ref name="ReleaseDate">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/13-455/Star-Wars-Legacy-3|text=Star Wars: Legacy #3}}</ref> The issue was written by [[John Ostrander]] and [[Jan Duursema]], and was also penciled by Duursema.<ref name="legacy3" /> The [[2008]] reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' establishes Kiefer's pronouns and incorrectly states that Oron Jaeger himself shoots Kiefer,<ref name="CSWE" /> rather than one of his stormtroopers doing it.<ref name="legacy3" />
